title: Grabby Grabber

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows you to pick up multiple objects at once

body:
"Some say it grabs, others say it grabby grabs! Use this tool to grab multiple objects at once with the power of wormholes!"

The Grabby Grabber is a tool which can be purchased for $26,000 at the Oak Depot. It allows the user to project a small zone that lets them pick up multiple loose objects.

Description

The Grabby Grabber is a makeshift power gauntlet with a claw on its end, built using a makeshift construction of wood and metal. Orange lights emit from it.

The main purpose of the Grabby Grabber is to pick up multiple objects at once. Using the tool causes it to project a small, transparent, shimmering orb a short distance away from the player in the direction they clicked/tapped. Any item within the orb at the moment of activation will be grabbed; any objects encountered after activation will not be added to the grabber's orb, and the grabber must be reactivated to grab more/different items. The grabber's orb and any objects caught in it follow the player's point of aim. Objects retain their mass while being grabbed. One notable difference from grabbing objects normally is that they will never rotate, only staying in the orientation they were in when they were grabbed. Because of the fact that objects cannot be rotated, this frees up the SHIFT key, allowing the player to run while moving multiple objects at once.

The Grabby Grabber will automatically drop held objects after 12 seconds.

Trivia

  • Prior to the map revamp, the Grabby Grabber was sold at Jer's Junkyard for $22,569.
  • The Grabby Grabber (and its Grabbiest counterpart) have been involved with multiple in-game tricks/exploits that allow for flight. The developers frequently have to patch tricks players use to fly.
  • The Grabby Grabber has a dim orange light that emits from the front when held, of which no counterpart exists on the Grabbiest Grabber.
  • Prior to a recent update, the Grabby Grabber was sold at the Lighthouse
  • The Grabby Grabber's design seems to take inspiration form the Gravity Gun from Half-Life 2.
    • It's upgraded counterpart, the Grabbiest Grabber also greatly resembles the Physics Gun from Gmod (which is a modified version of Half-Life 2).
